_rationale: Ages 60-61: no income, balance flat at 500k. Ages 62-65 (pre-2032): SS $30k/yr, 0% taxable, balance grows by 30k/yr. Age 66+ (2032+): SS $30k * 0.70 = $21k/yr (30% haircut), still 0% taxable, balance grows by 21k/yr. Default haircut year is 2032 (currentAge 60 → age 66 in 2032).
